begin declare @Trace table( [ID] bigint not null primary key clustered, [PRENT] bigint null, [STAMP] datetime not null, [SHRTN] nvarchar(256) null, [LONGN] nvarchar(max) null, [SIZEE] float null, [LEAVE] bigint null, [LEVEL] int null, [ORDER] int) insert into @Trace select [a].[ID] ,[a].[PRENT] ,[a].[STAMP] ,[a].[SHRTN] ,[a].[LONGN] ,[a].[SIZEE] ,[a].[LEAVE] ,[a].[LEVEL] ,row_number() over (order by [STAMP] asc) from [dbo].[TRACE] [a] with(nolock) where [a].[SESSN]=@sessn;
with [T] as ( select isnull([a].[LONGN],[a].[SHRTN]) [LONGN] ,sum(datediff(ms,[a].[STAMP],[b].[STAMP])) [DURTN] ,count([a].[ID]) [COUNT] ,sum(isnull([a].[SIZEE],0)+isnull([b].[SIZEE],0)) [SIZEE] from @Trace [a] inner join @Trace [b] on [b].[LEAVE]=[a].[ID] group by isnull([a].[LONGN],[a].[SHRTN]) ), [P] as ( select row_number() over (order by [a].[LONGN]) [ORDER] ,[a].[LONGN] ,[a].[DURTN] ,[a].[COUNT] ,[a].[SIZEE] ,case when [a].[SIZEE]<>0 then ([a].[SIZEE]/[a].[COUNT])/[a].[DURTN] else null end [VLCTY] from [T] [a] ) insert into @Output([ORDER],[LABEL],[DURTN],[DURTI],[COUNT],[SIZEE],[VLCTY],[DURTF]) select [a].[ORDER] ,[a].[LONGN] [LABEL] ,cast([a].[DURTN]/1000.0 as decimal(18,2)) [DURTN] ,cast([a].[DURTN]/[a].[COUNT]/1000.0 as decimal(18,2)) [DURTI] ,[a].[COUNT] ,[a].[SIZEE] ,cast([a].[VLCTY]*1000 as decimal(18,2)) [VLCTY] ,[dbo].[fn_str_fmt_timespan](null,[a].[DURTN]/60000.0) [DURTF] from [P] [a] return end
